'''Ride the Raging Rancor''' was a game that could be played in the [[Raging Rancor Cantina]], a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]]-themed [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located on [[Genarius]].

==The game==
Players would have to ride a mechanical Rancor without being thrown off. The only person ever to complete the game to its conclusion was [[Rrelbocco]], the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] of the Raging Rancor cantina.
